_about: Messages shown on Today when few outfits fit the weather (server/services/todaySelectionService.js decides the level, core/today/weatherNotice.js picks one). Edit freely: each list needs at least one message. Bands: cold below 10C, mild 10-20C, hot above 20C (today's daytime average).
